newsitem.title: USA: Conrail seeks dismissal of Norfolk suit.
newsitem.headline: Conrail seeks dismissal of Norfolk suit.

text.p: Conrail Inc on Monday asked a federal court to dismiss a Norfolk Southern Corp lawsuit seeking to block Conrail's intended merger with CSX Corp.
Conrail's motion said Norfolk Southern's suit was "legally deficient."
The motion was filed Monday morning in U.S. District Court for Eastern Pennsylvania, a Conrail lawyer said.
In the motion, Conrail said Norfolk Southern had no basis for a challenge either under Pennsylvania state law or federal law.

Conrail said Norfolk Southern was not a bona fide shareholder for purposes of filing a shareholder lawsuit alleging violation of fiduciary duty by Conrail's board under Pennsylvania law. It also said corporate charter amendments challenged by Norfolk Southern are specifically authorized under state law.

In addition, Conrail said it had amended its preliminary proxy statement to correct any alleged nondisclosures that formed a basis for Norfolk Southern's allegation that Conrail had violated federal securities regulations.

"Lawsuits should be based on principles and statutes; this lawsuit is based on frustrations and spite," Conrail said. "It is respectfully requested that this court dismiss all plaintiff's claims and allow the shareholders of Conrail the opportunity to decide their futures for themselves."
